title: Tank fill level control
goal: An operator can see automatic low-level filling, high-level cutoff, high-high alarm, and guarded manual fill.

rubric.must: LowLevel and normally closed HighLevel contacts visibly drive the FillRequest set coil.
A HighLevel contact visibly drives the FillRequest reset coil.
ManualOverride and normally closed HighHighLevel contacts visibly drive ManualFill.
FillRequest and ManualFill form visible parallel paths to the FillPump coil.
HighHighLevel visibly drives a HighHighAlarm set coil and the alarm visibly drives AlarmHorn.
AlarmResetPB with a normally closed HighHighLevel contact visibly resets HighHighAlarm.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: Image 1 visibly satisfies all six rules, while image 2 replaces the required set/reset logic and omits the latched alarm, horn, and alarm reset.
